2026_12_NE_LAC.summary: Drake Maye's fractured ankle: the market has Tommy DeVito starting, and our ratings still rate New England with Maye.

reasons.text: QB Drake Maye fractured his right ankle in the Week 10 loss in Munich and could miss the rest of the season; Tommy DeVito is expected to start.
New England comes off two straight blowout losses (Lions, Packers) and a bye; the game was moved to 4:05 PM ET Nov 29.

swings.LAC: QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle in Munich and Tommy DeVito is expected to start for New England, so the market moved to the Chargers; our ratings didn't (theScore, Nov 17).
swings.NE: Drake Maye's fractured ankle (Week 10) put Tommy DeVito at QB; the market marked New England down, our ratings still carry Maye (theScore, Nov 17).

2026_11_ARI_KC.summary: Arizona is down to its third QB (Josh Johnson expected to start); that covers part of the 2.5-point gap, while Kansas City's line and RB injuries push back.

reasons.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) is on IR after UCL surgery; Carson Beck (back spasms) did not practice Friday and Josh Johnson is expected to start.
The line opened Kansas City -13.5 and is now -16.5, moving 3 points with the Arizona QB news.
Pushing the other way: Chiefs G Trey Smith, OT Jaylon Moore and RB Kenneth Walker III are all ruled out.

swings.KC: Arizona lost Gardner Minshew and likely Carson Beck (Josh Johnson expected to start), so the market pushed Kansas City from -13.5 to -16.5; our ratings don't see QB changes (ESPN, Nov 20).

swings.MIN: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out and Kirk Cousins starts; the market dropped Minnesota, our ratings didn't (ESPN, Nov 20).

2026_11_MIN_SF.summary: Kyler Murray is out and Kirk Cousins starts, with WR Jordan Addison also out; that covers most of our 2-point gap.

reasons.text: QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) is ruled out; Kirk Cousins starts at San Francisco.
WR Jordan Addison is out after thumb surgery.
Partly offsetting: TE T.J. Hockenson and LB Blake Cashman are back; 49ers WR Mike Evans is questionable.

returning.text: TE (wrist) has no injury designation for San Francisco.

2026_11_NO_CHI.summary: New Orleans is missing three offensive line starters, which explains part of the 3-point gap; Chicago losing CB Kyler Gordon pushes slightly the other way.

reasons.text: Saints OT Taliese Fuaga (knee) and C Erik McCoy (biceps) are ruled out; OT Asim Richards (knee) is out for weeks: three line starters.
Chicago (7-2) comes off its bye; Circa lists Bears -10.5, so books differ by a point.
Pushing the other way: Bears CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder) is out.

2026_12_CHI_DET.summary: Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending ACL tear moved this line from Detroit -2.5 (spring) to Chicago -2.5; that's worth about 2 of our 4-point gap.

reasons.text: DE Aidan Hutchinson (torn ACL) is on IR and out for the season; C Cade Mays (ankle) is out this week vs. Tampa Bay.
The early (May) line had Detroit -2.5, so the market has swung about 5 points since then.

swings.DET: DE Aidan Hutchinson tore his ACL and is out for the season; the market marked Detroit down, our ratings haven't caught up (ESPN, Nov 18).

2026_12_NYG_IND.summary: The Colts cut QB Daniel Jones after a 26-3 loss at Houston and turn to Anthony Richardson, with both tackles and both top corners hurt; our ratings see none of it.

reasons.text: Indianapolis released starting QB Daniel Jones Friday; Shane Steichen named Anthony Richardson the starter, with Riley Leonard as backup.
In Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston the Colts played without OTs Bernhard Raimann and Jalen Travis and CBs Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward.
The line opened Giants -4.5 and is now -6.5, after the Jones release.

swings.NYG: Nothing Giants-specific (clean injury report); the market moved on Indianapolis' 26-3 loss and the Daniel Jones release (ESPN, Nov 20).

2026_12_NYJ_MIA.summary: Miami is on Kyle McCord with Malik Willis on IR, and Geno Smith is cleared for the Jets; that explains part of the gap, but some books still have Miami favored.

reasons.text: QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started the Week 10 loss.
Jets QB Geno Smith (ankle) has no injury designation this week after clean scans.
Books disagree: StatSniper shows DraftKings at Miami -1.5, against the Jets -3 we use.

swings.DAL: Dallas lost 46-40 to the 49ers in Week 10 and lost CB DaRon Bland and G Tyler Booker to high-ankle sprains for multiple weeks; our ratings were higher on Dallas before that (ESPN, Nov 16).
